**SECTION: Header / Branding**
*   **Logo (Top Right):**
    *   **Text:** Celsius
    *   **Tagline:** Experts in keeping things cool
    *   **Icon:** A stylized blue icon resembling a swirl or air current above the text.
    *   **Color:** Dark Blue text and icon.

**SECTION: Main Headline**
*   **Text:** JAGRO
*   **Style:** Very large, bold, sans-serif font.
*   **Color:** Light Cyan/Blue.

**SECTION: Visual Content (Image Grid)**
*   **Layout:** A 2x3 grid of photographs showcasing an installation project.
*   **Image 1 (Top Left):** Interior room with yellow walls, a window with black frames, track lighting on the ceiling, and a large digital display screen mounted on the wall. An indoor AC unit is visible high on the wall.
*   **Image 2 (Top Center):** Close-up of a white wall-mounted split-type air conditioner indoor unit installed on a light-colored wall.
*   **Image 3 (Top Right):** Exterior view of a building wall showing three outdoor AC condenser units mounted in a row. The brand "Panasonic" is visible on the units.
*   **Image 4 (Bottom Left):** Exterior shot of a two-story building with a black metal balcony structure, red-and-white striped awning, and a parked black car (looks like a Mahindra SUV) in the foreground.
*   **Image 5 (Bottom Center):** Interior view of a commercial space (likely a café or office) featuring a counter, kitchen area in the background, wooden flooring, and two wall-mounted AC units. A doorway leads to a restroom.
*   **Image 6 (Bottom Right):** Close-up of two large Panasonic outdoor AC units ("INVERTER" model) mounted on an exterior white wall.

**SECTION: Footer / Page Number**
*   **Content:** 17
*   **Style:** White text inside a dark blue rounded rectangle shape located at the bottom left corner.

**SECTION: Graphic Design Elements**
*   **Background Shape:** A large, abstract, semi-circular shape in the bottom right corner with a gradient from very light cyan to a solid medium blue.
*   **Color Palette:**
    *   Primary Blue (Logo/Footer): Deep Navy/Dark Blue (#003366 approx)
    *   Accent Blue (Headline/Shape): Light Cyan/Sky Blue (#AEEEEE to #0099CC gradient)
